messages:
Ethan Park: hey all, day 2 and hitting a kube permissions issue. followed the kubeconfig guide but when I try `kubectl get pods -n feature-x` I get Forbidden. any quick triage tips? /cc @DevEx

DevEx: welcome Ethan! can you paste `kubectl config current-context` and the exact error? also are you on Linux or mac?

Ethan Park: current-context is `redwood-dev`; I'm on Ubuntu WSL. error: 
```
Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "user:ethan.park@redwood.com" cannot list resource "pods" in API group "" in the namespace "feature-x"
```
`kubectl auth can-i list pods -n feature-x` -> "no"

DevEx: two quick things: (1) check if your Okta groups include `redwood:eng-platform` or `redwood:team-feature-x` (we gate namespaces by team groups), and (2) check your kubeconfig for duplicate/merged users (common when you copy from laptop). run `kubectl config view --minify --flatten` to confirm the user a context maps to.

Ethan Park: ran that and the context maps to `user:ethan.park@redwood.com`. I do see an old entry for `idp:epark@redwood.com` from when I tried a laptop restore. could that interfere?

DevEx: it can. easiest fix: `kubectl config unset users."idp:epark@redwood.com"` then re-run `kubectl config current-context`. But even with that you'll still need the Okta group binding for namespace access.

Ethan Park: I checked Okta groups, not in `redwood:eng-platform` or any team group. submitted the access form (ticket 7088).

InfraOps: we can apply a temporary RoleBinding to the namespace while People Ops adds you to the group. for audit cleanliness we prefer binding to a group, but temp user binding is fine for day-1. example we apply: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: onboarding-ethan-temp
  namespace: feature-x
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: "user:ethan.park@redwood.com"
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: feature-developer
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Would you prefer that or a serviceaccount kubeconfig we create for you?

Ethan Park: temp RoleBinding is fine so I can iterate on code/tests quickly. thanks.

InfraOps: applied onboarding-ethan-temp in feature-x, will auto-revoke when People Ops confirms the Okta group.

Onboard Bot: access request 7088 status: infra temp-binding applied (auto-revoke 24h).

Ethan Park: confirmed! `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n feature-x` -> "yes" and `kubectl get pods -n feature-x` shows the list. :tada: Also cleaned my kubeconfig to remove the old user entry.

People Ops: will add you to `redwood:team-feature-x` in Okta. expect group sync within 12 hours so infra can remove the temp binding.

DevEx: thanks for the report Ethan. two doc follow-ups: (a) add a short note to the quickstart about `kubectl config view --minify` and `kubectl config unset users."<old-user>"` for merged configs, and (b) add the temp RoleBinding snippet + the serviceaccount alternative for sensitive namespaces. I'll open a PR today. :thumbsup:

Ethan Park: huge help, thanks all. one tiny suggestion: include a line about `kubectx` and `kubens` in the docs for folks who switch contexts/namespaces frequently. saved me a minute or two :slightly_smiling_face:

DevEx: good call—will add a short recommended-tooling section (kubectx, kubens, kube-ps1).
